members.name: Complex
members.doc: Complex defines the operations that work on the builtin complex type. In short, those are: a conversion to complex, .real, .imag, +, -, *, /, **, abs(), .conjug

members.name: Integral
members.doc: Integral adds methods that work on integral numbers. In short, these are conversion to int, pow with modulus, and the bit-string operations.

members.name: Number
members.doc: All numbers inherit from this class. If you just want to check if an argument x is a number, without caring what kind, use isinstance(x, Number).
